title: keel generated lock
description: The keel-owned surface manifest, .keel/generated.lock.json, written by keel sync. It covers only files keel wholly owns plus the AGENTS.md managed block; shared runtime settings are never read, written or hashed. A hand-edited managed file is reported and never overwritten, and keel sync --check fails CI on drift.

kind.description: managed-block: the region between keel:managed markers in AGENTS.md.

runtime.description: Runtime the file serves, or null for shared surfaces.

generated_by.description: Template or generator id, for example templates/runtime/AGENTS.block.md.tmpl; the generatedBy value of the file's keel:managed marker.

sha256.description: sha256 of the generated bytes (for a managed block: the block content between the markers).
